observations: The exported candidate has one hand mesh and no duplicated third hand, but the dominant fingers do not read as a firm rifle grip or a trigger-index pose.
The validator measures a 3.2880 maximum matrix delta between the dominant wrist and weapon across sampled actions, so the weapon-fixed-to-strong-hand contract is not met.

At detach and carry the magazine is visible, yet its camera-facing silhouette is dominated by the feed tower and floor components and reads as stacked gray boxes rather than a finished curved M4 magazine.
At insert the magazine is mostly hidden behind the support hand and receiver, so contact and insertion cannot be verified visually.
The final state returns to the same ambiguous dominant grip and oversized support-hand silhouette.
ADS is centered and does not clip the camera, but the rear sight/carry-handle assembly and hands obstruct the sight picture.
